<h3 dir="auto">Describe the problem</h3>
<h4 dir="auto">Steps to reproduce:</h4>
<p dir="auto">Try logging in to a site using <code class="notranslate">signInWithRedirect</code>. Notably it redirects back to the site without an error, and does not log the user in. Checking <code class="notranslate">getRedirectResult</code> returns a null user.</p>

<ol dir="auto">
<li><code class="notranslate">signInWithPopup</code> does not work on mobile web browsers, you must use <code class="notranslate">signInWithRedirect</code></li>
<li>Firebase Hosting obviously isn't a universal soln, we aren't using Firebase Hosting</li>
<li>Authenticating with the OAuth provider sounds plausible, but this removes one of the huge benefits of using Firebase for authentication in the first place. Lots of eng work, having to implement and maintain OAuth flows manually for each supported provider.</li>

<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Is Fingerprint JS a service like described in <a href="https://blog.khophi.co/getting-started-with-fingerprintjs-pro/" rel="nofollow">https://blog.khophi.co/getting-started-with-fingerprintjs-pro/</a>? I wonder if the error is just saying that __/auth/iframe code is not hosted in customdomain.com (but it at .firebaseapp.com) and is flagging that as potentially malicious. Is there a way to allowlist this URL path?</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Thanks for the response <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/prameshj/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/prameshj" aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp">@prameshj</a> - Fingerprint JS is not something we are using in our app. It appears to be part of Google's Firebase auth flow via the SDK? It doesn't exist in our project itself.</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">the "getClientIdentity" in the stacktrace isn't coming from the auth sdk or the auth helpers... Do you have more info on where that code is from?</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">We found that this actually had nothing to do with Firebase or this open issue at all. The error and code injection was caused by our web application firewall. <p dir="auto">Thanks for the response <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/prameshj/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/prameshj" aria-keyshortcuts="Alt+ArrowUp">@prameshj</a> - Fingerprint JS is not something we are using in our app. It appears to be part of Google's Firebase auth flow via the SDK? <p dir="auto">the "getClientIdentity" in the stacktrace isn't coming from the auth sdk or the auth helpers... Do you have more info on where that code is from?</p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">We found that this actually had nothing to do with Firebase or this open issue at all. The error and code injection was caused by our web application firewall.
